verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents forwarding the business number to an external cell or mobile phone. Business-hours IVR routing to teams (aircall-docs-20), AI Agents taking after-hours calls (aircall-docs-24), and API tutorials for building overflow or smart-routing systems (aircall-docs-5, aircall-docs-7) are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not the requested call forwarding to a cell.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forward the business number to a cell when the team is away from the desk
